## Problem

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Provide steps and a minimal example using synthetic data and example hostnames.

## Environment

Include the project revision, operating system, Node.js version, and MCP client version if relevant.

## Checks performed

Describe any checks already performed and their results.

Do not attach real configuration, credentials, pairing codes, OAuth state, authorization URLs, databases, or unredacted logs. Report vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md.
